lead: Mohammad Babar Azam is a widely followed Pakistani cricketer, born on 15 October 1994 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 31 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has represented Pakistan national cricket team and Zarai Taraqiati Bank Ltd cricket team and has been recognised with the Sitara-i-Imtiaz.
